text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............
Man, look at everyone running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, Jordan, aren't you going to run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... 'Cause I'm making new nail tips.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
!? Did it get worse?
Your hoof...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Nah. More like,
my Trainer told me to! Or something.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They told me to look at an Umamusume running
and design fake nails inspired by her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're good with that?
Lame. Works totally fine for me, though.
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to observe closely.
Yeah, observe closely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Observation?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we'll need to study our opponents.
Though suddenly telling her to watch footage and analyze them...
might be asking too much of her right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: So I want to start by honing my "power of observation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By adding the act of observing and "drawing,"
her discernment should become even sharper
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Huh. Your Trainer comes up with some interesting stuff."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I know, right? Plus no one bugs me to study.
It's easy. And the tips went up too, so it's the best."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sure I've taught you a thing or two.
...Now then, watch how I run.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... City's running is so cool...
She's really digging into the turf...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Kyaa~! City-san, you're gorgeous--!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, she's actually strong, so makes sense.
Like, she really has a solid core, y'know?
If she were nails, glitter would be a total must."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I looked into the Classic-year Umamusume
who would become Tosen Jordan's rivals this year.
I thought I'd start with the Triple Crown route, but—
choice_data_list: Sure are a lot of features on the Tiara route...
There are a lot of features on the Tiara route...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tiara route. Every magazine was abuzz with excitement over this year's lineup of blockbuster rookies.
On the other hand, the Classic Triple Crown route was...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Sup~. I made 5 nail tips.
Pretty impressive, right? Aren't I great?
choice_data_list: You really observed everything thoroughly!
You've been observing things really carefully, haven't you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup~. Huh, that magazine...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
They're pretty famous, right? Like that cover girl.
The other day she was running on the track and everyone was going wild screaming for her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Still, isn't it crazy that she's getting featured in magazines too?
Talking about how strong she is.
Thanks to that, everyone's only talking about the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, isn't there zero mention of the Triple Crown route?
For our generation, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously? Why?
Does that mean you don't get interviewed if you do the Classic Triple Crown?
choice_data_list: I wouldn't really say so, though...
I don't really think so, though...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... this sounds too complicated. Pass. I'm gonna go make our last chip.
choice_data_list: Training starts in 30 minutes, got it?
Training starts in 30 minutes, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Look at 'em, everyone's still running.
Keep it up, keep it up~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, Palmer and Helios are here too.
Fast as always, huh...

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text:
Runaway sprint~!
Wild escape~☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So fast... So that's the
crazy runaway duo of Arima...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, everyone's looking.
LOL. Gotta take a video.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Are Palmer-senpai and
Helios-senpai running away again? Crazy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
“Pulling off a breakaway like that is super cool, though.
Isn't it romantic, in a way?”

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Palmer won two Grand Prix races,
the Arima and something else, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Helios won back-to-back titles in something too, I heard.
And City's obviously amazing, no surprise there.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's getting a nice amount of
attention, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …………Except for me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm going all out
right from lap one today. Keep your eyes on me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment training time began,
Tosen Jordan started running with
even more vigor than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her head was held higher while running than usual.
I feel like I've seen that somewhere before...
choice_data_list: Mejiro Palmer's running?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...How was it...? Was I faster...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...However, perhaps because she ran in an unfamiliar style,
her time was slower than usual.
choice_data_list: What do you think makes your running so good?
What do you think makes your running so good?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: The quality of your running?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer's running style... Her high head carriage seems to be a habit, but fundamentally, it's just incompatible with Tosen Jordan's style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was an escape born of sheer decisiveness and the resolve to keep fighting against herself
and holding on, even when she was left all alone in the lead."
choice_data_list: There is a strength unique to you in your running too.
There's a strength all your own in your running, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really what my running looks like?
choice_data_list: There is. What do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Like, 'the desire to win,' maybe?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
That's true.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! ...But that's not specific at all.
Wouldn't something more proper be better?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I don't get it at all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at a~ll!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she was growing.
It was as if she had become conscious of how others ran differently from herself
and could now mimic them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If you take more time to internalize your thoughts,
you should be able to grow even further."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we continued our training
with Tosen Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Hello, hello! Trainer-san!
How is Tosen Jordan-san doing?
choice_data_list: I'm searching for her weapon right now.

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! So you're in the middle of leveling up!
And you'll be showing it off at the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: O... owch!?
choice_data_list: Jordan!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: What's going on!?
What's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: M-My nail is... ouch...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beads of greasy sweat dotted her face.
The pain seemed to be extraordinarily severe.
choice_data_list: C-call an ambulance!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Putting her in the ambulance that rushed to the scene, we transported her to the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wee-woo wee-woo...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While riding it, her face
grew paler and paler..."
